ideas.title: Following the Money: Autism Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the $21 million autism fraud scheme in Minnesota and the potential for similar schemes in the state.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and investigate the funding and benefits associated with autism in Minnesota.
questions: How did the $21 million autism fraud scheme occur?
What measures can be taken to prevent similar schemes in the future?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a larger pattern of fraud and corruption in Minnesota, and could lead to increased scrutiny of autism-related funding and benefits.
